Subject: Executive Workshop Primer: slotting, presenter slots & travel wedge

Team —

Draft attached: Executive Workshop Primer v0.1 (short summary + objectives + proposed slot matrix). This kicks off alignment on three parallel things we need to lock this week for the Nov on-site:

1) Presenter slotting — who takes each 20/40/60 minute block. I sketched owners in the attached matrix but want confirmed names.
2) Pre-reads — who owns each pre-read and when we publish (target: publish to attendees by EOD Fri 10/22).
3) Travel wedge (arrival/departure windows) — Calyptus asked for a travel window they can coordinate with their execs; we should provide a recommended wedge and note travel constraints (VIP ground transit + one preferred evening dinner).

Ask: please update presenter_slot_matrix.xlsx with firm names and any slide-deck owners by end-of-day Thu 10/22. If you cant, reply with your constraints here.

High-level goals in the primer:
- Align executive priorities to the 90-minute strategy deep-dive (Day 1 AM)
- Reserve Day 2 for working sessions and product deep-dive demos
- Keep a single canonical pre-read (10 pages) + 3 appendices (ops, security, cost assumptions)

Attachments: 20261020_exec_primer_v1.pdf (primer), presenter_slot_matrix.xlsx (editable)

Mina
Director, Customer Programs
Redwood Inference

- AV ask: for my demo I need a wired HDMI fallback + a lapel mic. Marissa, can ops confirm AV?
